concepts.description: A module is a self-contained unit of the AUV system.
A robotic platform is a physical platform within the AUV system.
An interface defines a set of values or events.
A controller is a component that controls part of the AUV system.
A primitive type is a basic data type.
A composite type is a data type composed of values.
A value is a data element of a composite type or interface.
An event is a signal or message used in an interface.
A parameter is an input to an event or function.
A return value is an output returned by an event or function.
A function is an operation that takes inputs and returns outputs.

instances.description: AUV_Module is the module developed for the AUV system.
AUV_Platform is the robotic platform contained in AUV_Module.
Sensors is an interface used by AUV_Platform.
Actuators is an interface used by AUV_Platform.
AUV_Operator is the controller contained in AUV_Module.
Inputs is an interface used by AUV_Operator.
LRE_Ctrl is the Last Response Engine controller contained in AUV_Module.
Outputs is an interface used by LRE_Ctrl.
AUV_Autopilot is the autopilot controller contained in AUV_Module.
nat is the primitive type for natural numbers.
int is the primitive type for integers.
string is the primitive type for string values.
boolean is the primitive type for boolean values.
real is the primitive type for real numbers.
SVec is a composite type representing a spherical vector.
radial is a value recorded in SVec.
polar is a value recorded in SVec.
azimuth is a value recorded in SVec.
Obstacle is a composite type representing an obstacle.
ns_rel_dist is a value recorded in Obstacle.
ew_rel_dist is a value recorded in Obstacle.
depth is a value recorded in Obstacle.
id is a value recorded in Obstacle.
obs_hdng is a value recorded in Obstacle.
hdng is a value contained in the Sensors interface.
obs is a value contained in the Sensors interface.
Intpus is an interface that defines the specified events.
endTask is an event that ends a task.
reqOCM is an event that requests OCM.
reqMOM is an event that requests MOM.
reqHCM is an event that requests HCM.
reqVel is an event that requests velocity and returns a real value.
reqHdng is an event that requests heading and returns a real value.
advVel is an event that advises velocity and takes a real parameter.
advHdng is an event that advises heading and takes a real parameter.
Close is a composite type representing closest distance of approach data.
horiz_cda is a value recorded in Close.
vert_cda is a value recorded in Close.
odist returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle.
hdist returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle.
vdist returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle.
